CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes. Recommendation: Approve minutes of regular meeting on October 27, 2014 as written.
D-1. Oct 27 UB Minutes
2.
Amendment of Blanket Purchase Order to Olympic Staffing Services, a Temporary Employment Service. Recommendation: Approve and authorize an amendment in the amount of $20,000 to the Blanket Purchase Order issued to Olympic Staffing Services for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2015.
D-2. Olympic Staffing BPO Amend
3.
Approval of the Extension of Electric Rate "Schedule EV - Electric Vehicle Off-Peak Charging Discount". Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. UB-13-14 approving the attached Electric Rate "Schedule EV - Electric Vehicle Off-peak Charging Discount" to extend the off-peak discount for charging residential electric vehicles. A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND UTILITY BOARD OF THE CITY OF AZUSA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING REVISION OF ELECTRIC UTILITY RATE SCHEDULE EV TITLED "ELECTRIC VEHICLE OFF-PEAK CHARGING DISCOUNT" TO ENCOURAGE OFF-PEAK CHARGING OF ELECTRIC VEHICLES BY RESIDENTIAL CUSTOMERS
D-3.1. EV Rate Extension Rpt
D-3.2. Resolution- EV Extension
D-3.3. Schedule EV Extension
D-3.4. EV Application
4.
Approval of Notice of Completion for the Foundation and Slab Project W-276 at the Gladstone Yard. Recommendation: Accept the Foundation and Slab Project W-276, approve the Notice of Completion, and direct the City Clerk's Office to execute the Notice of Completion, record and file at the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder.
D-4.1. W-276 NOC Foundation Rpt
D-4.2. W-276 NOC Form
5.
Professional Services Agreement with Sustainable Environmental Management Company (SEMCO) d.b.a. Huls Environmental Management, LLC for Administration of Oil Payment Program. Recommendation: Waive formal Request for Qualifications (RFQ) and award a three-year professional services agreement to Sustainable Environmental Management Company d.b.a. Huls Environmental Management, LLC for the administration of used oil recycling payment program in amount of $19,140.
D-5.1. Semco Contract Rpt
D-5.2. Semco Proposal
D-5.3. Semco PSA 14-17
6.
Acceptance of Grant of Easement from Property Owner at the Rosedale Subdivision - Tract 54057-21 Lots 5,6,17 & 18. Recommendation: Accept the Grant of Easement by attached Resolution No. UB-14-14 for the Property located at Rosedale Subdivision in City of Azusa, Tract 54057-21 Lots 5,6,17 &18 owned by Azalea Rosedale, LP and Rosedale Land Partners II, LLC, and authorize the City Clerk to file the easement documents in the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD / CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA ACCEPTING A CERTAIN GRANT OF PERMANENT EASEMENT AND DIRECTING THE RECORDING THEREOF
D-6.1. Rosedale Grant of Easement Rpt
D-6.2. Resolution-Rosedale Grant of Easement
D-6.3. Rosedale Exhibit A Tract 5 & 6
D-6.4. Rosedale Exhibit B Tract 17 & 18
7.
Award Sole Source Contract for Paving the Intersection of 9th Street and Pasadena Avenue. Recommendation: Award of a sole source contract to Western Paving Contractors Inc. in an amount of $20,600, plus a 10% contingency, for paving the intersection of 9th and Pasadena Avenue.
D-7. Pasadena-9th Intersection Paving Rpt
8.
Cancellation of December Utility Board Meeting. Recommendation: Cancel the scheduled Utility Board meeting of December 22, 2014.
D-8. Dec UB Mtg
E.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
Adoption of an Updated Water Fund Cash Reserve Policy. Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. UB-15-14 to set the minimum unrestricted cash reserve target for the Water Fund at $19 million. A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA, CALIFORNIA, SETTING CERTAIN RESERVE POLICIES FOR THE WATER UTILITY ENTERPRISE FUND
E-1.1. Updated Water Reserve Policy
E-1.2. Water Fund Reserve Resolution-2014
2.
Approval of $4 Million Water Fund Loan to the General Fund. Recommendation: Approve a Loan Agreement to make a temporary loan from the Water Fund to the General Fund of $4 million and authorize execution of the necessary documents by the Interim City Manager and the Director of Utilities following acceptance of the Loan Agreement by the City Attorney.
